turns.question: What was the average number of customer service calls per day in September 2026, counting days with no calls as zero?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-calls-per-day metric, so I can't give that figure; the closest metric is Calls labelled (model-derived, labelled by gemini-3.5-flash under prompt v1), which counted 32 calls from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
